gates-of-olympus.description: An ancient-world setting, cascading symbols and multipliers that change the course of the bonus round. A look at the rules behind the spectacle.
gates-of-olympus.feature: Multipliers accumulate during free spins and apply to subsequent wins in the round.
gates-of-olympus.note: The game revolves around waiting for a multiplier. Its spectacle does not mean frequent payouts: the gaps between winning rounds can be long.

cards.title: Pays anywhere on the grid
cards.text: In the original Gates of Olympus, a win forms when 8 to 30 matching symbols appear on the grid. After a payout, the winning symbols disappear, and the cascade can continue within the same spin.

cards.title: Multipliers up to 500x
cards.text: Multiplier symbols can appear in both the base game and free spins. The official page for the original version lists values up to 500x.

cards.title: 15 free spins
cards.text: Four or more Scatters trigger the bonus game with 15 free spins. This is a separate mode, rather than a continuation of an ordinary cascade.

cards.title: Accumulating bonus multiplier
cards.text: During free spins, multipliers appearing on a winning spin are added to the accumulated value and applied to the corresponding win.

sweet-bonanza.description: Behind the fruit and sweets is a payout system without conventional paylines. Matching symbols are counted across the whole grid.
sweet-bonanza.feature: After a payout, symbols disappear to make room for new ones. Multipliers appear in the bonus round.
sweet-bonanza.note: A clear example of why presentation and the mathematical model are separate things. Light-hearted animation sits alongside high volatility.
sweet-bonanza.metricsNote: This figure applies to the original Sweet Bonanza, rather than the 1000 or Super Scatter versions.

cards.title: Pay Anywhere and tumbles
cards.text: Sweet Bonanza pays for 8–12 or more matching symbols anywhere on the grid. After a win, the symbols disappear and new ones drop from above, continuing the tumble sequence.

cards.title: 10 free spins
cards.text: Four to six Scatters trigger the bonus game with 10 free spins. The number of Scatters affects the separate scatter payout, but the starting number of spins remains ten.

cards.title: Candy Bomb 2x–100x
cards.text: Multiplier symbols with values from 2x to 100x can appear in the bonus game. They do not substitute for ordinary symbols and are counted after a winning sequence.

cards.title: Adding the multipliers
cards.text: At the end of a winning tumble, the values of all the multipliers that appeared are added together and applied to that sequence's win. The relevant figure is their total, rather than an individual symbol.

book-of-dead.description: An Egyptian adventure with ten paylines and an expanding symbol. A straightforward base game and a distinctive bonus.
book-of-dead.feature: During free spins, the selected symbol can expand across an entire reel.
book-of-dead.note: The mechanic becomes understandable after a few rounds. Most of the variety is concentrated in the bonus game, rather than the base spins.

cards.title: 5 × 3 and 10 paylines
cards.text: Book of Dead uses a conventional 5 × 3 grid and ten paylines. Read the base game as a payline slot, rather than a modern cascading system.

cards.title: The book is both Wild and Scatter
cards.text: The book symbol has two roles: it substitutes for ordinary symbols as a Wild and also counts as a Scatter for triggering free spins.

cards.title: 10 free spins
cards.text: Three Scatters activate the Free Spins feature and award 10 spins. The bonus changes the role of the selected special symbol, rather than the grid.

cards.title: Special expanding symbol
cards.text: One ordinary symbol is selected at random before free spins. During the bonus, it can expand on reels when that expansion creates an additional payout on the active paylines.

reactoonz.description: Chain reactions on a grid of one-eyed creatures. Neighbouring groups replace paylines, alongside energy accumulation and symbol transformations.
reactoonz.feature: Cluster wins charge a meter that activates a sequence of game effects.
reactoonz.note: The most rule-intensive game in this selection. Start by understanding the energy meter: without it, the action can look like an arbitrary sequence of effects.

cards.title: Clusters on a 7 × 7 grid
cards.text: In Reactoonz, a win begins with a cluster of five or more matching neighbouring creatures. Read groups across the entire 7 × 7 grid, rather than paylines running from left to right.

cards.title: A cascade after a cluster
cards.text: The symbols in a winning cluster disappear, and new ones drop from above. One paid round can therefore contain several consecutive clusters.

cards.title: Energy for Gargantoon
cards.text: Each winning cluster contributes energy to the Gargantoon progress system. Follow the meter separately from the current win amount.

cards.title: Quantum Leap
cards.text: Once fully charged, Gargantoon moves to the centre of the grid and starts a chain reaction of special features. The official description of the original game specifies a sequence of up to five effects.

the-dog-house.description: Dogs, kennels and sticky Wild symbols. A conventional grid with an emphasis on combinations of multipliers.
the-dog-house.feature: During the bonus round, Wild symbols stay fixed on the reels until it ends.
the-dog-house.note: Persistent Wilds make the bonus progression easy to follow. Accumulating symbols does not, however, guarantee the final outcome.
the-dog-house.metricsNote: This figure applies to the original The Dog House, rather than Megaways, Multihold or other sequels.

cards.title: 5 × 3 and 20 paylines
cards.text: The original The Dog House is a payline slot with a 5 × 3 grid and 20 paylines. Distinguish it from the series' later Megaways and Multihold versions.

cards.title: Wilds with multipliers
cards.text: Wild symbols appear on the central reels and carry multipliers. Their value depends on whether they participate in a particular winning payline.

cards.title: Sticky Wilds
cards.text: During free spins, Wilds become sticky and remain in their positions. This is an accumulating part of the bonus, but does not guarantee a final payout on its own.

cards.title: The original bonus and potential
cards.text: Three bonus paw symbols trigger Free Spins mode. In the original game's release, Pragmatic Play stated potential wins of up to 6 750x the stake, separately from the specifications of later versions in the series.
